en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a small European town scene with traditional houses, a mill-like industrial building with chimneys, and a narrow watercourse crossed by a simple bridge. A group of adults and children stand on the bridge and along a fence, posing for the photograph. Trees and timber-framed architecture are visible. Red printed captions appear at the top and bottom of the image.
